verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a Python scripting API and AppleScript automation, so scoping what an agent may do through that API is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can issue scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The user-supplied OpenAI key for the AI feature is an outbound credential the user provides, not one the product issues, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
